live_state.last_completed: **SPEC-124 — restore the decided least-privilege grant model (2026-08-21)**. Live Primary contradicted migration `202607043400` on both of its explicit decisions: `anon` held full DML on all 72 public tables and `authenticated` held `DELETE`/`TRUNCATE`. Root cause was Supabase's hosted `pg_default_acl`, invisible to `db reset` + smoke-test because the local stack carries no such default. Migration `202607050200` restores the model, revokes the default ACL so future tables cannot re-inherit it, and removes the implicit PUBLIC EXECUTE on `app` functions.
